headlines.title: McDonald’s Is Rallying, but Can You Sleep at Night Owning It?
headlines.summary: McDonald's stock has jumped 20% in a month, yet one podcast host says weight-loss drugs make it impossible to own. Another host points to a hidden real estate empire. Which argument holds up when traffic and franchisee discipline get tested?

headlines.title: McDonald's: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
headlines.summary: The margin story rests on a 98% franchised target, and whether baseline traffic can carry that model through 2028 is still open.

headlines.title: Why McDonald's Stock Popped Today
headlines.summary: New value menus are bringing bargain hunters back to the burger chain's restaurants.

headlines.title: McDonald’s (MCD) Stock Jumps As Q3 Earnings Beat Meets Growth Questions
headlines.summary: McDonald's stock jumped higher today, rising 6.6% to about US$280 after Q3 2026 earnings were released. Traders focused on straightforward headline numbers. Adjusted earnings per share came in at US$3.57 and restaurant-level profit reached nearly US$4.2b in the quarter. This short-term move sits against a slower grind in the longer-term story. Revenue over the trailing twelve months is US$27.8b, and current earnings forecasts indicate only mid single digit annual growth.

headlines.title: McDonald's pushes cheaper meals as customers cut back
headlines.summary: Customers looking to spend less may find more value-focused offers, but how consistently those deals are available may depend on franchisees.

description: McDonald's Corporation owns, operates, and franchises restaurants under the McDonald's brand in the United States and internationally. It offers food and beverages, including hamburgers and cheeseburgers, various chicken sandwiches, fries, shakes, frozen desserts, sundaes, soft serve cones, cookies, pies, soft drinks, coffee, and other beverages; and full or limited breakfast, as well as sells various other products during limited-time promotions. The company owns and operates franchised restaurants under various structures, including conventional franchise, developmental license, or affiliate. McDonald's Corporation was founded in 1940 and is based in Chicago, Illinois.
